title: pilosella cymiflora subsp. tubulata
intro: Pilosella cymiflora subsp. tubulata, commonly known as False Sow Thistle or Saw Wart, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing fever, soothing wounds, and treating skin conditions like eczema and acne, making it a valuable asset in natural remedies. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella cymiflora subsp. tubulata include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
